1809-8043-8350.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1809-8043-8350.description:
Cast Face Yourself for free due to Vision, targeting yourself and creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste and the noted exile clause.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters, it triggers, returning Face Yourself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

681-5414-6621-8345.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-5414-6621-8345.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Repeat from step 2.

2760-4279-6273.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2760-4279-6273.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2760-4279-6273.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

4289-4770-4927-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

215-7296-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
215-7296-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Loot from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Loot by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

5058-6495-7396.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
5058-6495-7396.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3174-5571-8095--6.description:
Use Switcheroo to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2374-3899-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Maja triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-6972-7338.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Putrid Pals.
When Putrid Pals dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-6143-6798.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6143-6798.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Feywild Caretaker from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Feywild Caretaker.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Feywild Caretaker token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6143-6798.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

2136-4836-6567.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Dragonhawk with haste.
When the Dragonhawk tokens enter the battlefield, they each trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling a number of cards from the top of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.
At the beginning of your end step, each Dragonhawk token triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent for each card exiled by the Dragonhawk tokens that were not played.
2136-4836-6567.notes: Assuming you control no other creatures with power 4 or greater, this combo can deal up to 60 damage to each opponent. This is reduced by 2 for each card you play that is exiled. For every additional creature you control with power 4 or greater, this combo deals up to an additional 10 damage per creature to each opponent.

2511-4907-6556-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
2511-4907-6556-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

1978-4131-7329.description:
Animate Basalt Monolith using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Basalt Monolith.
Repeat from step 2.

1402-2218-4460-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-1649-5346.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken artifact creature with mana value 3 or less.
You have an artifact creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
1636-1649-5346.description:
Activate Goblin Engineer by paying {R}, tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken artifact creature with mana value 3 or less, targeting another artifact creature with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
When the artifact creature dies, Goblin Engineer and Crime Novelist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}.
Resolve the Goblin Engineer ability, returning the targeted artifact creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the artifact creature enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

538-3490-4369-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
538-3490-4369-4659.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Impact Tremors triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impact Tremors triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Impact Tremors triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

1292-3110-3117-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1115-2440-3581-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1115-2440-3581-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

2366-3688-4068-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3688-4068-5702.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2366-3688-4068-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-4702-4891-5056.description:
Turn Atsushi into an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Atsushi by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Put the Atsushi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Atsushi token dies, it triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Atsushi.
Repeat from step 2.

585-1399-1606-6984.notablePrerequisites: Evendo has at least twelve charge counters on it. You control at least three creatures.
585-1399-1606-6984.description:
Activate Unnatural Seleciton by paying {1}, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Evendo, Waking Haven by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Evendo, Waking Haven.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

1580-2018-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Reassembling Skeleton from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from steps 1 and 5
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3188-4017-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3188-4017-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

880-6517-6664.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-6517-6664.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4222-4758-5149-5516.easyPrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
Power Artifact attached to Crossroads Candleguide.
4222-4758-5149-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
4222-4758-5149-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

277-1479-2907-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
277-1479-2907-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and each Scute Swarm you control trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve a Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve a Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

961-2781-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Against All Odds.
961-2781-4605.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

147-167-413.description:
Cost Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Repeat steps 3 through 6 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it and the Wicked Role token attached to it trigger.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Repeat from step 9.

877-3001-5231.description:
Cast Mortus Strider by paying {1} due to Morophon.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Mortus Strider, adding {R}.
When Mortus Strider dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2084-3668.notablePrerequisites: Flesh Duplicate is a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
2084-3668.description: Activate Flesh Duplicate by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Flesh Duplicate into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

851-1563-2457-2837.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste.
Activate the Cats by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1069-2837-3552-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2837-3552-5499.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Cat.
Activate the Cat by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

509-893-1636.notablePrerequisites: Idris does not have summoning sickness.
509-893-1636.description:
Activate Idris using Myr Turbine's first ability by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
When the Myr enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
Once you control five or more Myrs, you may instead use Myr Turbine's second ability until all Myrs in your library are put onto the battlefield.

2544-3883-4857.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
2544-3883-4857.description:
Activate Temple Bell by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and create a Treasure artifact token for each opponent you have.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U}, untapping Temple Bell.
Repeat.
If you have four or more opponents, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

539-4552-5189.notablePrerequisites: Ghave has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
539-4552-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by sacrificing the Saproling, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ghave.
Repeat.

997-1109-1123-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Skeleton Ship does not have summoning sickness.
Flayer of the Hatebound does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
997-1109-1123-1636.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound.
Flayer of the Hatebound dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Flayer of the Hatebound enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Flayer of the Hatebound trigger, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Skeleton Ship by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Flayer of the Hatebound.
Repeat.

1558-1908-3263-4690.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five basic lands.
1558-1908-3263-4690.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Phylath with haste.
Put the Phylath token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Phylath token enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating at least five 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Plant tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

222-2714-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-2714-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Siege-Gang Commander and Slimefoot and Squee, adding two mana in any combination of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Siege-Gang Commander from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Siege-Gang Commander and Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Siege-Gang Commander trigger, creating three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing two Goblins, Siege-Gang Commander and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana and infinite Goblins, you may activate Siege-Gang Commander's ability infinitely to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

839-1849-2105-4284-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five modified creatures.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
You control a Mountain.
839-1849-2105-4284-5256.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and Unforgiving One as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Unforgiving One triggers, returning Clone from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Combat Celebrant.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Combat Celebrant, causing target player to mill cards equal to Combat Celebrant's power.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Clone and Unforgiving One as attackers, choosing to exert Clone as it attacks.
Clone triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Unforgiving One triggers, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Clone, causing target player to mill cards equal to Clone's power.
Repeat.
